method: Mean raw token vectors across all 20 samples per context; subtract gene mean across contexts within cohort/layer; joint GTEx+TCGA PCA50/UMAP per layer
limitations: Organ correspondence is not cell-type matching or patient pairing; new visualization cohort differs from the original quantitative benchmark. Independent layouts by layer; visual separation is not an effect size; averaged contexts hide within-context heterogeneity
cohort_scope: Separate visualization cohort; original benchmark numerical results unchanged
